subject: fix(server): invalidate backend status cache after implicit installs (#3926)
summary: Adds an RAII scope guard to BackendManager::install_backend() so that SystemInfoCache::invalidate_recipes() is called whenever backend installation finishes — including early returns and exception paths — fixing stale /system-info backend status in the GUI3/App after implicit installs.
verdict_reason: The fix is a clean four-line RAII guard approved by a subject-matter maintainer with no post-approval churn, but the user-visible behavior change — backend status shown by the GUI after an implicit install — was exercised only in the author's local environment and not on a release candidate build.
